action.objective: Advance the a-pawn to a5, create a passed pawn, and hold the verified strongest exact score in the endgame.
action.rationale: a4a5 is the sole commit_ready move: verification at full depth 4 gives exact score -112 (strongest exact evidence), safety complete with no mating reply, and tactical_refutation not_found. Broad depth-3 search showed all alternatives bound=upper (possibly worse), so a4a5 is the only reliable choice. Black's likely continuations Bxf2 or Rxd3 win pawns but are not forced mates, and no candidate scored higher.
